rationale: Fix is correct, minimal, mirrors established pattern at KdsOrderCard.vue:355, bundles are properly recompiled and contain the guard. However: (a) the same PENDING_CREATE leak persists on AT LEAST 5 OTHER admin surfaces displaying orderUser.phone / administrator.phone / deliveryBoy.phone — owner only patched what they personally saw in the navbar dropdown, not the systematic exposure surface; (b) the Q12 KDS bundle staleness sentinel is KDS-only and will NOT catch future regressions in admin-shell / admin-reports / pos-app bundles where 3 of the 4 fixed components live; (c) zero Vitest unit specs exist for any of the 4 fixed components — only manual visual proof via screenshot; (d) a pre-existing latent bug at ProfileEditProfileComponent.vue:115 (country_code = profile.first_name) sits literally on the line immediately after the new guard but was not noticed. None of these block the fix shipped — they extend its scope.

findings.title: 5+ admin surfaces still leak PENDING_CREATE phone sentinel (incomplete patch surface)
findings.evidence: PosOrderShowComponent.vue:307 `orderUser.country_code + '' + orderUser.phone` (no guard); TableOrderShowComponent.vue:246 same; OnlineOrderShowComponent.vue:292 same; AdministratorShowComponent.vue:87-88 `administrator.phone ? administrator.country_code + '' + administrator.phone : ''` (truthy-check passes for PENDING_CREATE_xxx string); DeliveryBoyListComponent.vue:95-96 same truthy-only check. All 5 render User model rows where User::creating injects `PENDING_CREATE_<hex>` when phone is null (app/Models/User.php:106-119). The 4 fixed components covered Admin navbar + chat header + credit-balance table + profile-edit form, i.e. only the path the owner walked through visually. A Soak Cashier or Client Comptoir user with PENDING_CREATE injected phone WILL render the raw sentinel as soon as a POS/Table/Online order references them or an admin opens the Administrators / Delivery Boys list.
findings.fix_suggested: Apply the identical guard `phone && !String(phone).startsWith('PENDING_') ? country_code + phone : ''` to the 5 surfaces listed. Better: extract a tiny Vue mixin or global filter `displayPhone(user)` so the guard lives in ONE place (the inline ternary will continue to drift). The existing pattern at KdsOrderCard.vue:349 is already a computed property — that is the established right shape. Recommend a vue/composables/useDisplayPhone.js export both as a function for `<script>` and a global filter for templates.

findings.title: Inline ternary duplicated 4× — refactor opportunity missed
findings.evidence: Identical pattern `xxx.phone && !String(xxx.phone).startsWith('PENDING_') ? ... : ''` now appears at BackendNavbarComponent.vue:127, MessageListComponent.vue:41, CreditBalanceReportComponent.vue:88, ProfileEditProfileComponent.vue:114, PLUS the long-form `customerPhone()` computed at KdsOrderCard.vue:349. Five surface copies of the same business rule = drift risk: if the sentinel format changes (e.g. PENDING_CREATE_ → PENDING_USER_), 5 sites must be updated and one will be forgotten.
findings.fix_suggested: Extract a `helpers/phoneDisplay.js` exporting `displayPhone(user)` returning '' when phone is missing or starts with `PENDING_`, and use it everywhere (already-fixed and UR1-001 surfaces). Single source of truth, testable in isolation with Vitest.

findings.title: Q12 KDS bundle staleness sentinel does NOT cover admin-shell / admin-reports / pos-app bundles
findings.evidence: tests/js/sentinels/kdsBundleFreshnessSentinel.spec.js:116 only watches `public/js/admin-kds.js` against KDS-specific Vue sources. 3 of the 4 fixed components compile into admin-shell.js (Navbar + Messages + Profile) and admin-reports.js (CreditBalance) — these bundles are NOT under any freshness sentinel. A future contributor editing BackendNavbarComponent.vue and forgetting `npx mix` would ship a stale admin-shell.js silently with no test failure.
findings.fix_suggested: Generalise the kdsBundleFreshnessSentinel.js helper (already exported on globalThis.__assertBundleFresh at line 112 of the spec, anticipating reuse) into siblings: adminShellBundleFreshnessSentinel.spec.js (watches resources/js/components/layouts/backend + resources/js/components/admin/messages + admin/profile + admin/dashboard against public/js/admin-shell.js), adminReportsBundleFreshnessSentinel.spec.js (watches credit-balance + sales-report + etc. against admin-reports.js), posAppBundleFreshnessSentinel.spec.js. The infra is ready — just stamp the pattern.

findings.title: Zero Vitest unit coverage for the new guard — only manual screenshot proof
findings.evidence: `find tests/ -name '*BackendNavbar*' -o -name '*ProfileDropdown*' -o -name '*MessageList*' -o -name '*CreditBalance*' -o -name '*ProfileEditProfile*'` returns empty. The fix relies on a screenshot in tests/e2e/__screenshots__/fix-pending-create/02-profile-dropdown-open.png as its only proof. Edge cases unproven: phone=null, phone=undefined, phone=number (1234), phone='PENDING_' (no suffix), phone='pending_create_xyz' (lowercase — current code WILL show this because String.startsWith is case-sensitive).
findings.fix_suggested: Add `tests/js/unit/helpers/phoneDisplay.spec.js` (assuming the helper extracted per UR1-002). Cover the 7 edge cases enumerated in the brief: null/undefined/empty/real/PENDING_CREATE_xyz/PENDING_/lowercase. Owner must decide whether lowercase 'pending_create_xyz' should also be blocked — current sentinel injector at User.php:108 always uses UPPERCASE so realistically it cannot occur, but a stricter case-insensitive guard is one more `.toUpperCase()` away.

findings.title: Pre-existing copy-paste bug on adjacent line ProfileEditProfileComponent.vue:115
findings.evidence: Line 115 `this.form.country_code = profile.first_name;` — `country_code` is being set to `first_name`. Bug NOT introduced by this commit (git blame: pre-existing). Mitigated by the immediate dispatch at line 117-119 which overwrites form.country_code with the real calling_code. Net effect: transient wrong value during the ~1-2 frames between line 115 and line 119 resolution. Worth fixing as a one-line drive-by (`this.form.country_code = profile.country_code || '';`) since the editor was already on this exact line for the new guard.
findings.fix_suggested: Replace line 115 with `this.form.country_code = profile.country_code || '';` to remove the misleading copy-paste artifact. Zero behavior change in steady state; cleaner audit trail.

findings.title: BackendNavbarComponent guard string is 132 chars — exceeds 120-char soft cap for Vue templates in this codebase
findings.evidence: BackendNavbarComponent.vue:127 produces a single line `{{ authInfo.phone && !String(authInfo.phone).startsWith('PENDING_') ? (authInfo.country_code || '') + authInfo.phone : '' }}` — measured 132 characters in template. No .editorconfig at repo root setting max_line_length, so technically permitted, but adjacent template lines are all <100 chars. Slightly harder to scan during code review.
findings.fix_suggested: Either accept (no enforced rule) or extract to a computed property `displayAuthPhone` (preferred — matches the KdsOrderCard.vue:349 computed pattern, makes it Vitest-testable without spinning up the full Navbar component).

findings.title: Pattern divergence — KdsOrderCard.vue uses computed property + early return, new fix uses inline ternary
findings.evidence: Established pattern at KdsOrderCard.vue:349-358 is a computed property `customerPhone()` with a multiline early-return. The new 4 fixes are inline ternaries. Both are functionally correct; the ternary form is shorter but loses the inline comment block citing Sprint 5A Z9-P1-03 + telephone link rationale that lives in the KdsOrderCard version. Future maintainers will see the inline ternary without the breadcrumb.
findings.fix_suggested: If extracting a shared helper per UR1-002, the comment lives once in helpers/phoneDisplay.js. If keeping inline, add a one-line comment `// [GOAL Phase A ADV-A-001 2026-05-25] Hide PENDING_CREATE sentinel injected by User::creating` above each ternary.

findings.title: Defensive coercion via String() is correct for non-string phone (numeric, BigInt)
findings.evidence: All 4 new ternaries use `String(phone).startsWith('PENDING_')` — handles phone=null (coerced 'null', NOT starting with PENDING_, kept), phone=undefined ('undefined', kept) BUT the outer `phone && ...` short-circuit converts null/undefined to falsy → returns ''. Net behavior is correct: null/undefined/'' → ''; number 1234 → '1234' rendered (no PENDING_ prefix); 'PENDING_CREATE_xyz' → '' (correct).
findings.fix_suggested: No action required — current implementation handles all numeric/null/undefined coercion gracefully. Document this in the unit test once extracted (UR1-004).

architect_summary: Fix is scope-minimal, follows the Sprint 5A Z9-P1-03 pattern, +4/-4 LOC across 4 Vue templates, frozen-zone diff = 0 verified. The patch is technically correct but TACTICALLY narrow: owner patched the surfaces they saw, not the underlying systemic exposure. At least 5 more admin Vue components render the same User.phone field without the guard (PosOrderShow, TableOrderShow, OnlineOrderShow, AdministratorShow, DeliveryBoyList). The duplication of the inline ternary (now 5 sites including KdsOrderCard) creates drift risk — a shared helper `displayPhone()` is the right architectural move. The line-115 country_code = first_name pre-existing copy-paste bug sits literally one line below the new guard and was missed during the touch.
tester_summary: ZERO Vitest unit coverage for any of the 4 fixed components — proof rests on one Playwright screenshot for the navbar dropdown only. Edge cases unproven (null, undefined, lowercase 'pending_create_xyz', numeric, empty string). Bundle integrity empirically VERIFIED: `grep -c "startsWith('PENDING_')"` returns 1+ occurrences in admin-shell.js (2), admin-reports.js (1), pos-app.js (1), admin-kds.js (1), app.js (1) — all rebuilt. HOWEVER, the Q12 KDS bundle staleness sentinel ONLY watches admin-kds.js — admin-shell, admin-reports, pos-app are NOT under freshness lock, so a future Vue edit forgetting `npx mix` would ship stale bundles silently. This is the most consequential test-debt gap: the bundle pattern that owner mandated (Q12) is half-finished.
missed_surfaces: resources/js/components/admin/administrators/AdministratorShowComponent.vue:87-88 (administrator.country_code + administrator.phone — truthy-only check, PENDING_CREATE is truthy)
edge_case_gaps: phone='PENDING_CREATE_xyz' → returns '', untested but visually proven
phone='PENDING_' (no suffix, exactly the prefix) → returns '', untested — unlikely in practice but edge
phone='pending_create_xyz' (lowercase) → WILL RENDER raw lowercase sentinel because startsWith is case-sensitive — owner decision needed (User.php:108 always uppercase so unreachable in practice)
phone=12345 (numeric) → String() coerces to '12345', renders correctly, untested
